Current assessment — 2026-10-05

Reviewed against local main 7057a8d5a2d898c1bfb528a28f3f635dda639b8b, origin/main 568ce108 (local main clean, 112 ahead/0 behind at audit; no push).

Where we are: S0 source qualification spike is on main via recovery; native ML and common global-AR preparation are now current engineering prerequisites. The old 17-20% smoke refusals and preview timings are historical, not current pilot claims.

Fresh context: Yes: delivered spike / acceptance reconciliation.

Next action: Credit the delivered S0 receipt and map its exact acceptance; use current stable-energy and AR source in future rehearsal. Do not rerun the old spike simply to restart the packet or reuse its observations as confirmation.

Evidence: docs/verification/phrf-cmp-s0-20261001.md; docs/verification/phrf-pilot-integration-20261004.md; docs/verification/consolidation-20261005.md.

This is a tracker/source/retained-evidence assessment, not a new experiment or test run. Existing acceptance criteria and owner decisions remain binding; dated source-state statements below are superseded where this assessment explicitly corrects them. Status, priority, assignee, claims and dependency edges are unchanged.

---

Previous scope and history (acceptance retained)

Per design fc698d6e §6 S0. At bound source 8d5b0e51: run the existing ProfileHrf ML executor suites (JVM and JS), plus a 40-voxel smoke fit of a condition (Gaussian) fit and a trial TrialRandomEffectsML fit, on one harness-seed generator dataset with ONE global pooled AR(1) plan (owner O1). Record timings for the five pilot timing quantities as a preview (not the pilot). No production changes; spike code only under tools/phrf-comparison/spike/ or a test-scope path.
